thread:
Maya: FYI PR #4215 preview failing linkcheck and Vale warnings. Looks like an external redirect on the deploy guide changed — linkcheck is flagging it as a broken/redirected link. This PR is blocking a docs merge slot tomorrow. Can someone triage? /cc @Simon

ci-bot: docs-linkcheck failed for PR 4215 — 3 issues. Logs: https://ci.redwood/in/job/7643
Failures:
 - docs/guides/deploy.md: line 78 -> https://example.com/old-guide -> 301 redirect
 - docs/intro/quickstart.md: line 12 -> https://old-templates.io/ -> 404
 - docs/sdk/python.md: line 203 -> https://pypi.python.org/project/redwood-inference -> 410

Simon: I can take deploy.md and sdk/python.md. Will swap to stable URLs. For the quickstart 404, that template repo moved; we should point to the new GH path or add a redirect exception. Thoughts?

Olivia: Vale also flagged passive voice in deploy.md after the recent edits — a few short sentences. We should keep the tone consistent. I can adjust wording unless there's a specific phrasing we need to preserve.

Jack: heads-up on merge timing: we have a docs merge window tomorrow 10:00–11:00 UTC. If this needs editorial review, we should finish before 09:45 UTC. If it's just URL swaps it's safe to do as a quick patch.

Maya: thanks. @Simon can you PR fixes onto my branch (or push to this branch)? Quick patch is fine. Please include a commit message like: `doc: fix linkcheck + vale`

Simon: on it. Replacing the 404 with https://github.com/redwood/templates/blob/main/quickstart and updating pypi -> https://pypi.org/project/redwood-inference/

Simon: quick sed I used locally to replace the pypi link:
```
sed -i 's|https://pypi.python.org/project/redwood-inference|https://pypi.org/project/redwood-inference/|' docs/sdk/python.md
```
Pushing now.

ci-bot: rerun requested by Simon — docs-linkcheck queued: https://ci.redwood/in/job/7643/rerun

docs-bot: Preview updated for PR 4215 — https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/4215 (URL will be live in ~90s). Vale run results: 1 warning left (style/passive) at docs/guides/deploy.md: line 120

Olivia: I pushed a tiny wording tweak to remove passive voice: "We deploy the model" -> "Deploy the model" (keeps imperatives used elsewhere). That should clear Vale.

ci-bot: docs-linkcheck passed. vale-check passed. All checks green ✅

Maya: great—thanks everyone. @Jack can you slot this into the 10:00 UTC merge window? If there are no objections I'll merge at 10:05.

Jack: slot confirmed. :thumbsup: Merge away at 10:05 if green.

Maya: merging now — thanks team!
